regions.region: left column, Scheme 1 and its surrounding introductory prose
regions.finding: Mechanistic background only: generic Pd(0)/Pd(II) and Pd(II) Heck-type pathways, classified as a mechanism rather than a reported experiment.

regions.region: right column, Scheme 2 and preceding prose
regions.finding: Generic depiction of the authors' cited prior work with functionalized allenes and coordinating halides; classified as a literature example, with no new row-level experiment assigned.

regions.region: right column, lower prose beginning 'As a first try'
regions.finding: Reports the initial PdCl2/DMF experiment (Table 1 entry 1, 41%) and the optimized Pd(OAc)2/DMF experiment (Table 1 entry 13, 58%); these are cross-linked to the corresponding page-2 rows rather than duplicated.

regions.region: left-column author footnote at page bottom
regions.finding: The article states that supporting information is available online, but no SI file was supplied or explicitly associated in this workspace; no SI association was inferred.

unresolved: Supporting information is mentioned but was not supplied or explicitly associated.
Scheme 1 and Scheme 2 use generic R/CG/FG groups and therefore do not define complete molecular structures.

regions.region: upper-left Table 1, entries 1-13 and footnotes a-b
regions.finding: Thirteen distinct optimization experiments were read row by row. Footnote a assigns 10 mol% catalyst to entry 2; the shared arrow and footnote b support 5 mol% for the other rows, including the structure-only catalyst in entry 7.
Proposed competing mechanistic pathways A and B with intermediates 4-8; retained as one mechanism record, not converted into reported experiments per arrow.

Deuterium-labelling probe: 1a and deuterated bromide 2c with 5 mol% Pd(OAc)2 in DMF at 80-90 °C for 1.5 h gives only 3i in 52% yield, with both D atoms reported at the terminal carbon of the acyclic alkene.
Pd(0) probe: 1a and 2a with 5 mol% Pd(PPh3)4, 1 equiv K2CO3, and 1 equiv Bu4NBr in DMF at 100 °C for 3 h gives only product 9 in 96% yield.

regions.region: lower-right Table 2, entries 1-5 and footnotes a-b
regions.finding: Five substrate-scope rows were inspected. Entry 1 is the same 1a+2a to 3a experiment as Table 1 entry 13 and the page-3 typical procedure, so it was merged with that record. Entries 2-5 are four independent scope records. Footnote b changes 2d to 10 equiv in entry 4.

unresolved: Table 1 and Table 2 do not state the yield measurement basis except where the page-3 typical procedure establishes isolation for the merged 3a experiment.
Table 2 provides a shared 90-100 °C range rather than an exact row-specific temperature for entries 2-5.
The exact identity/SMILES of the structure-only Table 1 entry-7 palladacycle and depicted products 3a-e, 3i, and 9 remain unverified.
Reactant amounts for Equations (1) and (2) are not reported on the supplied page.

regions.finding: Detailed preparation of 3a from 1a and 2a with Pd(OAc)2 in DMF at 100 °C for 1 h, followed by ether dilution, water washing, MgSO4 drying, evaporation, and silica-gel chromatography; 37 mg (58%) of 3a was isolated as an oil. This enriches the existing Table 1 entry 13/Table 2 entry 1 record.

regions.region: upper-left characterization paragraph following the typical procedure
regions.finding: NMR, EIMS, IR, and HRMS characterization for 3a is source evidence for product identity but is not a separate reaction experiment.
Bibliographic references and prior literature only; no additional experiment from this paper was created from the reference list.

unresolved: The reaction atmosphere is not reported in the supplied typical procedure.
No explicitly associated supporting information was provided.
Product 3a has not been independently structure-verified; its SMILES remains null.
